name: kosovo-tax-optimization
description: Compare lawful Kosovo small-business tax methods for tax year 2026 after identifying whether the taxpayer is a sole trader or a company. Covers the separate personal and corporate gross-income ceilings, quarterly trade/service payments, the real-income election and its continuing term, ordinary deductions, losses and dividend classification. Trigger on Kosovo tax planning, 3 percent trade tax, 9 percent services, gross versus profit taxation, company versus sole trader, deductible costs and dividend extraction. Produces a documented comparison rather than an automatic recommendation to incorporate or switch methods. Read with the linked income-tax, corporate, pension and VAT skills; complete employer/owner costs and unresolved health implementation need separate evidence.
